cues: Welcome to Class 12 Biology, Unit 2: Plant Physiology.
In Unit 1 we built the plumbing of a plant.
Now we switch it on: water climbs, light becomes sugar, sugar becomes energy, and a plant that cannot walk still finds ways to move.
